channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio repete afirmação falsa sobre mesários votarem no lugar de eleitores ausentes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro repeated a false claim about poll workers voting in place of absent voters during a live broadcast. The statement was made in a video for followers on Saturday (24), the eve of the runoff election.

item.title: Brasil do Povo (24/10/26) | Completo
item.description: The October 24, 2026 episode of 'Brasil do Povo', hosted by Katiuzia Rios, covers news and journalistic debates on national topics. The content reflects RedeTV!'s typical coverage, focusing on politics, economy, and Brazilian current events.

item.title: Os pontos fortes e fracos de Lula e Flávio nas redes sociais na véspera do segundo turno
item.description: Lula leads the IPDE with 55.6 points, excelling in digital reach and favorable sentiment after the debate, while Flávio Bolsonaro keeps higher engagement and follower growth. Despite the digital advantage, polls show a technical tie in voting intention.

item.title: Ao menos 139 mil eleitores têm o local de voto trocado no 2º turno
item.description: 139,207 voters had their polling locations changed between the first and second rounds of the 2026 elections, affecting 442 sections in 22 states, according to TSE data. The Southeast region leads with 28.1% of cases, followed by the Northeast with 27.5%. Experts warn that these changes may increase voter abstention due to insecurity and misinformation among voters.

item.title: Nunes Marques recua e libera frota federal para levar indígenas
item.description: The President of the Brazilian Electoral Court, Kassio Nunes Marques, reversed his previous decision and allowed the use of federal vehicles and boats to transport indigenous people, quilombola communities, and traditional populations in the second round of elections, following pressure from the Attorney General's Office and a court ruling in Pará. Despite the relaxation, each transport operation still requires prior approval from the Electoral Court.

item.title: 442 seções eleitorais mudaram do 1º para o 2º turno; leia a lista
item.description: 442 polling stations were changed between the first and second rounds of the 2026 elections, affecting 139,207 voters, according to TSE data. Changes occur due to logistical issues such as renovations, accessibility improvements, and weather conditions. Voters can check their polling location via the e-Título app, online self-service, or ChatVote.

item.title: Ato de Lula ocupa 14 quarteirões da avenida Paulista
item.description: President Lula held the campaign closing rally on Paulista Avenue, with at least 14 city blocks occupied and an estimated 2 million attendees according to the PT. The security team blocked high-resolution aerial footage, and Lula expressed concern about crowd density and people fainting.

item.title: Em live com Janones, Lula pede mobilização "até o último voto"
item.description: In a 24-hour livestream hosted by André Janones, Lula urged supporters to maintain their mobilization until the end of the second-round elections, highlighting the enthusiasm of the attendees. He thanked the protesters and emphasized the need to work until the last vote, expected on Tuesday.

item.title: Presença de eleitor nas urnas vira fator decisivo neste domingo após maior abstenção em 1º turno
item.description: The 2026 presidential runoff faces the highest abstention rate since 1998, with 21% of voters absent in the first round, making mobilization of non-voters a decisive factor. The campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro seek to attract the 33.7 million voters who did not vote, while student movements supporting the PT candidate organize street protests to increase participation. Analysts highlight factors such as apathy, protest, and mobility issues as reasons for low turnout.

item.title: Eleições 2026: 7 momentos da campanha de Lula à Presidência da República
item.description: Lula's 2026 presidential reelection campaign enters a tight runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro after a surprising first-round result. Despite unexpected support from figures like André Janones, the strategy focuses on rebuilding Flávio's image and building a broad coalition.

item.title: Da ordem para cancelar ‘dates’ à chegada do ‘marechal’: A rotina no ‘Exército do Lula’
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones leads the 'Exército do Lula' channel, which grew from 60,000 to 10 million followers in 17 days, mobilizing supporters through 'missions', including canceling romantic dates, while awaiting Lula's potential administration of the group. The strategy aims to organize voters after Mauro's defeat in the first round, though the channel was suspended twice by the TSE for electoral risks.

item.title: Brasil vai às urnas em clima de vale-tudo, com fratura exposta e briga acirrada entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: The presidential runoff campaign ends in intense polarization between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, with a technical tie in polls and high voter abstention. The scenario of fierce confrontation and mutual wear suggests a narrow victory for either candidate, with challenges in governing a divided country. Street protests and heated debates mark the closing of the most turbulent race since redemocratization.

item.title: Bastidores do STF: o que está em jogo para Moraes nas eleições deste domingo
item.description: The STF anxiously awaits the 2026 election results, as Minister Alexandre de Moraes' future directly depends on whether Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro wins. A Lula victory would be seen as salvation for Moraes, while a Flávio win could intensify impeachment pressures. Moraes has adopted an ambiguous strategy, combining conciliation with investigations that may impact the PL candidate.

item.title: Dilemas, futuro e o que move o eleitor: o capítulo final da disputa entre Lula e Flávio em análise
item.description: The presidential race between Lula and Flávio heads into the second round focused on public security, electoral justice, and corruption allegations. Despite tight polling, targeted strategies are essential to sway undecided voters and determine the winner.

item.title: Eleições 2026: 7 momentos da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro à Presidência da República
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads the 2026 presidential campaign with a slight edge over Lula (PT), according to polls, following his first-round victory and strong electoral performance by his party. The campaign was marked by euphoria, coalition-building with right-wing allies, and mobilization ahead of the October vote. While Bolsonarists trust in victory, PT supporters bet on polling trends.

item.title: Lula discursa para apoiadores da janela de sua casa, em SP, e diz que 'vitória é do povo brasileiro'; veja vídeo
item.description: Lula spoke to supporters from his window in São Paulo, emphasizing early voting and reaffirming that victory belongs to the Brazilian people. He also attended the campaign's closing event on Paulista Avenue, highlighting the need for structural changes in the country. The president encouraged attendees to convince others to vote in the second round.

item.title: Homem é preso após atropelar crianças em ato pró-Flávio em Ilhabela
item.description: A man was arrested after hitting two children during a pro-Flávio Bolsonaro parade in Ilhabela (SP). The suspect, who had Lula-support stickers, was detained by attendees and taken to the police station.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro direcionam vídeos para Carlinhos Maia após influenciador citar dúvida sobre voto
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro recorded videos directed at influencer Carlinhos Maia, who expressed uncertainty about his vote in the 2026 election runoff. Both candidates adopted a conciliatory tone, with Lula highlighting Maia's business success and Flávio emphasizing national unity in change. The approaches followed Maia's declaration that he did not vote in the first round but plans to vote on Sunday.

item.title: Rali: agregador do GLOBO mostra Flávio Bolsonaro com 50,6% e Lula em 49,4%, um dia antes do 2º turno
item.description: One day before the runoff, the Rali survey aggregator from GLOBO and Instituto Locomotiva shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 50.6% of voting intentions, against 49.4% for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The tool also indicates that 47.8% of voters approve of Lula's government, while 46.8% disapprove.

item.title: Nunes Marques pede vigilância e senso crítico com notícias no 2º turno
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, urged the population to remain vigilant and use critical thinking when receiving information during the second round of elections, warning against sensationalist and accusatory news. He emphasized the importance of checking polling locations, using tools such as e-title, and ensuring the secrecy of the vote.

item.title: STF torna réu blogueiro Oswaldo Eustáquio por atos do 8 de Janeiro
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Court indicted bolsonarista blogger Oswaldo Eustáquio as a defendant for criminal association related to the January 8 attacks, citing social media posts and participation in protests challenging Lula's inauguration. Declared a fugitive, Eustáquio is currently in exile in Spain after fleeing to Paraguay. Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes emphasized that freedom of expression does not protect speeches promoting violence or undermining republican institutions.

item.title: Procuradoria eleitoral se opõe à suspensão do “Exército do Lula”
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry opposed the suspension of the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel, stating that coordinated mobilization of supporters does not constitute electoral irregularities on its own. The opinion was issued after a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, which accused the channel of promoting artificial engagement actions. The PGE recommended that Meta clarify the publication of a paid ad directing users to the channel.

item.title: Datafolha: no DF, Flávio Bolsonaro tem 56% de votos válidos, e Lula, 44%
item.description: A new Datafolha poll released on October 24, 2026, shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading with 56% of valid votes in the Federal District, against 44% for Lula (PT). The survey, with a margin of error of two percentage points, interviewed 1,620 voters between October 23 and 24.

item.title: A última pesquisa Futura sobre a disputa entre Flávio e Lula antes do segundo turno
item.description: The latest Futura Inteligência survey, conducted between October 23 and 24 with 2,000 voters and a 2.2-point margin of error, shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) tied within the margin of error, with 50.1% and 49.9% of valid voting intentions, respectively.

item.title: Lula e Flávio lotam ruas em BH, Rio e São Paulo; veja imagens
item.description: Lula and Flávio held their final campaign rallies across Southeastern cities, with gatherings in Copacabana, Paulista Avenue, and Belo Horizonte. Lula criticized SUS privatization proposals and referred to Flávio as 'military', while Flávio emphasized Minas Gerais' importance to the election. Both candidates will use free electoral time on Sunday for final speeches.

item.title: Quaest: Lula chega a 58% entre mais pobres, enquanto Flávio Bolsonaro marca 57% junto aos mais ricos
item.description: A Quaest survey reveals that Lula leads among the poorest (58%) and Flávio Bolsonaro among the rich (57%), maintaining a technical tie overall (51% vs 49%). The senator expanded his advantage in the low-income bracket, while Lula remained stable in the middle-income group. Despite government approval and fear of Bolsonaros being considered factors, the scenario suggests a possible swing among Lula supporters.

item.title: Presidente do TSE reforça que eleitores devem checar local de votação antes de votar
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, gave an official statement urging voters to check their polling station before heading to vote in the 2026 runoff elections. The announcement aims to ensure a smooth and orderly electoral process.

item.title: Nunes Marques revisa decisão e autoriza transporte de indígenas sob regras da Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, authorized the transportation of indigenous, quilombola, and traditional community voters for the October 25 runoff election, provided that electoral judges pre-approve the routes and operations. The decision revises a previous ruling and requires the federal government to submit logistical details, including vehicles, routes, boarding points, and voter numbers, to the Regional Electoral Courts. Each electoral judge will have up to two hours to approve operations within their jurisdiction.

item.title: Quaest: Flávio tem 51% e Lula, 49% dos votos válidos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads with 51% of valid votes against Lula (PT) at 49%, according to a Quaest poll, but the two-point difference matches the margin of error, keeping the race technically tied. Including blank/null votes, both candidates hold 46% and 45% respectively, with 8% undecided or voting null.

item.title: Em Brasília, atos por Lula e Flávio ficam a 2 km de distância
item.description: In the center of Brasília, supporters of Lula and Flávio gathered about two kilometers apart, keeping confrontations under control and repeating the word democracy. Despite minor street encounters, the groups reaffirmed their distinct positions, highlighting criticism of misinformation and political polarization.

item.title: Presidente do TSE alerta para desinformação e pede que eleitores desconfiem de ataques a candidatos e à Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, warned about misinformation in the final stretch of the 2026 elections, urging voters to remain vigilant and critical toward sensationalist or accusatory messages against candidates and the Electoral Justice. He also emphasized the importance of ballot secrecy, checking polling locations, and ensuring electoral regularity for the second round.

item.title: Na véspera da eleição, Flávio Bolsonaro faz live com artistas sertanejos
item.description: On the eve of the 2026 elections, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) held a live stream with country music artists Gusttavo Lima and Rodolffo, highlighting cultural support for his campaign. During the broadcast, he discussed public management and commitment to the needy, reinforcing his presidential candidacy.

item.title: Nunes Marques orienta checagem do local de votação e reforça sigilo do voto
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, advised voters to check their polling station before leaving home, following over a thousand changes in electoral sections between the first and second rounds. He also emphasized the importance of voting secrecy and clarified that voters who did not participate in the first round can vote in the second.

item.title: Idealizador da Ficha Limpa declara voto em Lula no 2º turno: ‘Contra a tirania’
item.description: Márlon Reis, creator of the Ficha Limpa law, announced his vote for Lula in the 2026 runoff, warning of power concentration risks if Flávio Bolsonaro wins. The former judge believes a PL government would threaten Brazil's democratic institutions.

item.title: O que as últimas pesquisas indicam para o resultado neste domingo, segundo modelo estatístico
item.description: A statistical model aggregating 50 surveys from 20 institutes assigns 89% probability of victory to Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and 11% to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) for the runoff. The projection indicates 51% of valid votes for Flávio and 49% for Lula, considering factors such as abstention and historical polling errors.

item.title: Pesquisa Lula x Flávio segundo turno: veja os números atualizados de hoje
item.description: Today's (24th) polls for the runoff between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) show a technical tie, with variations within the margin of error. The race remains tight, reflecting the electorate's polarization. Voting intentions suggest a close election in 2026.

item.title: Sem ir a eventos de Flávio, Michelle participa último ato de campanha no DF
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro participated in the final campaign rally of the second round in the Federal District alongside Governor Celina Leão. During the campaign period, she did not attend any events with Flávio Bolsonaro. The event included a walk through Brasília with the local governor.

item.title: Veja o resultado das últimas pesquisas para governador em 5 estados e no DF
item.description: Recent polls in six states and the Federal District reveal the electoral landscape ahead of gubernatorial runoff elections, focusing on voter behavior in Acre, Amazonas, Brasília, Espírito Santo, Rio Grande do Norte, and Tocantins. The surveys highlight competitive races and uncertainty around definitive outcomes.

item.title: Quem está na frente das pesquisa hoje, véspera do 2ş turno? Veja levantamentos
item.description: Surveys ahead of the 2026 runoff show a tight race between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with differences within the margin of error. No candidate leads clearly.

item.title: Flávio na pesquisa para presidente: veja últimos números do segundo turno
item.description: Surveys released on the eve of the 2026 Brazilian presidential runoff showed Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) numerically ahead of Lula (PT), within the margin of error. The race remains tight, with no clear frontrunner between the two candidates.

item.title: Como último estado do Nordeste com 2º turno deve votar para Presidência, segundo pesquisa
item.description: An AtlasIntel survey reveals that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads with 63% of valid votes in Rio Grande do Norte, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) secures 37%. The approval rating of Lula's government in the state is 61%, based on a poll with a two-percentage-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Quaest, 2º turno: veja intenção de voto por região, gênero, idade, identificação política, renda e religião na véspera da eleição
item.description: A Quaest poll released before the Brazilian 2026 runoff shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 51% and Lula (PT) at 49% of valid votes. The survey interviewed 3,702 voters between October 23 and 24, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level. Segments analyzed include region, gender, age, political identification, income, and religion.

item.title: Em último ato antes do segundo turno, Grass pede "voto com consciência"
item.description: Leandro Grass (PT) closed his DF gubernatorial campaign with a call for conscientious voting and real change for Brasília residents. At a rally on the Ministries Esplanade, Grass urged citizens to vote with love, conscience and common sense, reinforcing his ethical and grassroots governance agenda. He also sharply criticized his opponent Celina Leão (PP), emphasizing differences on rights and the role of the State.

item.title: Candidatos à Presidência reúnem apoiadores no último dia de campanha
item.description: On the final day of the campaign, Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva held public rallies with supporters in Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, and São Paulo. Flávio emphasized privatization plans and slogans like 'Fora Lula', while Lula criticized the tone of the opposing campaign and promoted dialogue. Both candidates used the events to rally voters ahead of the runoff.

item.title: USP não vai divulgar público de atos de Flávio e Lula deste sábado. Entenda
item.description: The Political Debate Monitor (USP/Cebrap) and the NGO More in Common Brazil decided not to release audience estimates for the pro-Lula and pro-Flávio events held in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, after Lula's security team blocked drone usage during the peak of the rally. The decision aims to ensure fairness between the events, preventing underestimation of the number of supporters.

item.title: Quaest: aprovação de Lula é maior que desaprovação pela 1ª vez desde agosto
item.description: Lula's approval rating rose to 48%, surpassing disapproval (45%) for the first time since August, according to a Quaest survey released ahead of the second round. Flávio Bolsonaro leads voting intentions with 51% against Lula's 49%, within the margin of error.

item.title: Quaest e Datafolha: 'muito ruim' para Lula, apesar de empate técnico; colunistas do GLOBO analisam pesquisas
item.description: Datafolha and Quaest polls show a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula in the runoff, with 51% and 49% of valid votes respectively. GLOBO columnists suggest Lula may have reached a ceiling in growth, while Flávio holds a slight edge within the margin of error.

item.title: Flávio x Lula: veja resultado das últimas pesquisas para presidente
item.description: The latest polls for the runoff between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) show a slight numerical advantage for Flávio, within the margin of error. Surveys by Quaest, Datafolha, CNT/MDA, BTG/Nexus, and AtlasIntel reveal minimal differences, with Flávio leading by 1 to 2 percentage points in valid votes.

item.title: Nunes Marques reconsidera decisão e autoriza uso da frota de órgãos federais para transporte de indígenas no 2º turno
item.description: The president of the TSE, Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, reconsidered a prior decision and authorized the use of federal fleet to transport Indigenous, Quilombola, and traditional community voters in the second round, provided each operation is previously approved by electoral judges. The PGR requested the STF to suspend this requirement, arguing that the bureaucratic procedure may hinder the access of thousands of Indigenous people to the polls on Sunday.

item.title: Bandeirão da Democracia Corintiana é levado a ato de Lula na Paulista
item.description: At his final campaign rally before the 2026 presidential runoff, Lula displayed a Corinthians flag bearing the slogan 'Democracia Corintiana,' symbolically linking football and politics. The gesture echoed the club's historical role in Brazil's redemocratization, notably Sócrates' advocacy for direct elections during the 1984 Diretas Já movement.
